title: Wordmark Clearspace
slide_intent: Give a long wordmark enough separation so neighboring text does not become part of its silhouette.
strategic_value: Consistent breathing room can keep the Burger King name distinct across narrow applications.
demonstration: A red wordmark spans a shaded horizontal clearance diagram; U specimens mark the surrounding buffer.
practical_value: Measure the wordmark’s minimum clearspace with its Burger U width.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The defined minimum separates the wordmark from all other visual and verbal elements.

ingredient.name: Wordmark clearspace
ingredient.role: Prevent adjacent content from crowding the name.
ingredient.application: Reserve a minimum Burger U width around the wordmark.
